## Linked proposal and decision
Issue, reviewed version, vote record if substantive, and recorded voting result. If editorial or evidence-only, explain that classification.

## What changes and why
Purpose served and effects on the complete framework.

## Review and evidence
Sources, alternatives, unresolved objections, minority view, and material changes since voting.

## Integration checklist
- [ ] Proposal status and empirical claims are accurately distinguished.
- [ ] Substantive adoption links the frozen roster, applicable tier, quorum and approval checks, ballot record, and exact voted text. Discussion-only intake remains clearly proposed; editorial work is classified with reasons.
- [ ] README, plan, reference register, decision record, and changelog are updated where affected.
- [ ] PDF and text editions are regenerated when required; all PDF pages are visually checked.
- [ ] Links and original reference IDs are preserved or explicitly corrected.
- [ ] Contributor permission or applicable license for substantial text is recorded.
- [ ] Final diff matches the reviewed proposal; new substantive changes have renewed review.

## Approval and completion
A final text check must confirm that this commit faithfully implements the voted proposal; no additional founder approval is required. Maintainer records the merge commit and closes the linked proposal only after verification.
